entries.en: to happen to meet; to encounter by chance
to bump into while walking; to stumble against
entries.notes: 汉字"踢/踶"存疑，据西语 encontrar tropezando 与音写 tâ câ 定踩踏碰撞义。

entries.en: to run into; to collide with
entries.notes: M 栏首字声号 T99（污损难辨）且"槐/槌"存疑，据"撞"字与西语 dar en…（撞于）定碰撞义。

entries.en: to meet each other; to encounter one another
to conceal; to keep silent about
entries.notes: 汉字"瞞/賄"存疑，据西语 encubrir–callar 与音写 moa 定"瞒（隐瞒）"义。

entries.en: to shelter (stolen goods)
entries.notes: 汉字"窝/富"存疑，据西语 encubrir 与本页窝字系列（密窝、窝盗、窝家）定为"窝藏"。

entries.en: to conceal (bad habits); to avoid, shirk
to cover up; to conceal and keep silent

entries.zh: 藏匿留己；藏起来据为己有
entries.en: to conceal so as to keep (them) for oneself
entries.notes: 汉字"軀/趣"存疑，据西语 encubrir para quedarse con ellos（藏留己有）定释义。

entries.en: to conceal and carry off with them; to hide from all sides
entries.notes: 西语词头换行残断（darse con ellos / encubrirse de todas），释义兼取两读，与第 9 条同词形。

entries.en: to cover up with words; to excuse oneself verbally
entries.notes: 汉字"趣聞/趣開"与音写 ā chà 均难确证所对应词形，仅据西语 encubrir de palabra 定口头遮掩义。

entries.zh: 窝藏盗贼；盗贼藏身之密窝
entries.en: to harbor thieves; hidden den of thieves
to harbor thieves; to shelter robbers
to screen; to shelter from view
to hush up one's faults (as taboo); to scruple to mention
to conceal one's faults by silence
to cover up and hush up (faults)
to conceal; to hide (merits and greatness)

entries.zh: 窝家；窝藏赃物（窝藏路上劫掠赃物之家）
entries.en: harborer of stolen goods; to shelter loot taken on the road
entries.notes: 缩写 dho=d[ic]ho 依推断展开；hustiado 按 17 世纪拼写读作 hurtado（赃物），与汉字"窝家"义相合。

entries.en: crossroads; intersecting road
entries.notes: 西语词头 Enorucijada 判读为 Encrucijada（十字路口）之形误，与"横路"义相合。
